SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  date,
  visitNumber,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  totals.transactions,
  device.deviceCategory,
  h.hitNumber,
  h.type,
  h.transaction.transactionId,
  h.transaction.transactionRevenue,
  h.time
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  AND h.type = 'TRANSACTION'
LIMIT 20

WITH pageviews AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitNumber, visitId, hits.hitNumber, hits.time, hits.page.pagePath,
         LEAD(hits.page.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) as next_page,
         LEAD(hits.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) as next_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as hits
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign = 'Data Share Promo'
    AND hits.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pageviews
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_page, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_page IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_page
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) = 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(FLOOR(MAX((next_time - time) / 1000)) AS INT64) as max_time_seconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT np.next_page, mt.max_time_seconds
FROM next_page_counts np
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%B %Y', month_date) AS month,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(add_to_cart, product_detail_views) * 100, 2) AS add_to_cart_conversion_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(completed_purchase, product_detail_views) * 100, 2) AS purchase_conversion_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_date,
    COUNTIF(hits.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2') AS product_detail_views,
    COUNTIF(hits.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3') AS add_to_cart,
    COUNTIF(hits.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6') AS completed_purchase
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hits
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
  GROUP BY month_date
)
ORDER BY month_date

-- Final calculation
WITH new_user_initial AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitNumber,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
),
all_new_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM new_user_initial
),
initial_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime,
    date,
    timeOnSite,
    transactions
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      fullVisitorId,
      visitStartTime,
      date,
      timeOnSite,
      transactions,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime) as rn
    FROM new_user_initial
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
qualified_initial AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitStartTime
  FROM initial_visits
  WHERE timeOnSite > 300
),
purchase_check AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT qi.fullVisitorId
  FROM qualified_initial qi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` gs
    ON qi.fullVisitorId = gs.fullVisitorId
    AND gs.visitStartTime > qi.visitStartTime
    AND gs.totals.transactions > 0
  WHERE gs._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT pc.fullVisitorId), COUNT(DISTINCT anu.fullVisitorId)) * 100 as percentage
FROM all_new_users anu
LEFT JOIN purchase_check pc ON anu.fullVisitorId = pc.fullVisitorId

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(CAST(temp AS FLOAT64), 1) AS avg_temperature,
  ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64), 2) AS precipitation
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12' AND year BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
ORDER BY year

SELECT latitude, longitude, 
       PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', CAST(month AS STRING), '-', CAST(day AS STRING))) as date,
       AVG(wind_speed) as avg_wind
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2005`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2006`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2007`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2008`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2009`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2015`
)
WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY latitude, longitude, year, month, day
ORDER BY avg_wind DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date,
  temp AS avg_temp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009` 
WHERE stn = '723758' AND mo = '10'
ORDER BY temp DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: day of week and hour with most trips from top station in 2018
WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
day_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY day_of_week
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT day_of_week FROM day_counts ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 1) as day_of_week,
  (SELECT hour_of_day FROM hour_counts ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 1) as hour_of_day

SELECT
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND)),
    COUNT(*) * 60
  ) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pu ON t.pickup_location_id = pu.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` do ON t.dropoff_location_id = do.zone_id
WHERE pu.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND do.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01 00:00:00')
  AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-08 00:00:00')
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10

WITH trip_distances AS (
  SELECT
    t.bike_number,
    2 * 6371000 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((ST.latitude - ss.latitude) / 2), 2) +
      COS(ss.latitude) * COS(ST.latitude) *
      POWER(SIN((ST.longitude - ss.longitude) / 2), 2)
    )) AS distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` ss
    ON t.start_station_id = ss.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` ST
    ON t.end_station_id = ST.station_id
)
SELECT
  bike_number,
  SUM(distance_meters) AS total_distance_meters
FROM trip_distances
GROUP BY bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 1000.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    subscriber_type,
    total_minutes,
    SUM(total_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY subscriber_type ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
),
monthly_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE NULL END) AS customer_cumulative,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE NULL END) AS subscriber_cumulative,
    ABS(
      MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE NULL END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE NULL END)
    ) AS abs_diff
  FROM cumulative
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  month,
  ROUND(abs_diff, 2) AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM monthly_diff
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH berkeley_stations AS (
  SELECT CAST(station_id AS INT64) as station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE r.name = 'Berkeley'
),
berkeley_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(t.start_station_longitude, t.start_station_latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(t.end_station_longitude, t.end_station_latitude)
    ) as distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  WHERE t.start_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM berkeley_stations)
    AND t.end_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM berkeley_stations)
    AND t.duration_sec > 0
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(MAX(distance_meters / duration_sec), 1) as highest_avg_speed_mps
FROM berkeley_trips
WHERE distance_meters > 1000

SELECT 
  a.country_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.age < 20 THEN a.population ELSE 0 END) as pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.age < 20 THEN a.population ELSE 0 END), m.midyear_population) * 100, 2) as pct_under_20
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m
  ON a.country_code = m.country_code AND a.year = m.year
WHERE a.year = 2020
GROUP BY a.country_name, m.midyear_population
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH averages AS (
  SELECT 
    'United States' AS country,
    AVG(CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_anxiety_2019,
    AVG(CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_depression_2019,
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_anxiety_2020,
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_depression_2020
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
    AND date >= '2019-01-01'
    AND date < '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  country,
  avg_anxiety_2019,
  avg_depression_2019,
  avg_anxiety_2020,
  avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_anxiety_2020 - avg_anxiety_2019, avg_anxiety_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_depression_2020 - avg_depression_2019, avg_depression_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM averages

SELECT 
  team_market,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as distinct_players
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
WHERE period = 2
  AND points_scored >= 15
  AND season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
GROUP BY team_market
ORDER BY distinct_players DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Final query: 2 rows - one for timberland, one for forestland
WITH latest_eg AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        MAX(evaluation_group) as latest_eg
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
    SELECT 
        p.plot_sequence_number,
        p.state_code,
        p.expansion_factor,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN latest_eg le ON p.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group = le.latest_eg
    WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        c.plot_sequence_number,
        c.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.reserved_status_code,
        c.site_productivity_class_code,
        c.proportion_basis,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN 
                fp.expansion_factor * c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * 
                    CASE WHEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot ELSE 1 END
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 
                fp.expansion_factor * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted *
                    CASE WHEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot ELSE 1 END
            ELSE 0
        END as acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN filtered_pop fp ON c.plot_sequence_number = fp.plot_sequence_number AND c.state_code = fp.state_code
),
state_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
        SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    GROUP BY state_code
),
timberland_max AS (
    SELECT state_code FROM state_totals ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC LIMIT 1
),
forestland_max AS (
    SELECT state_code FROM state_totals ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
    'timberland' as category,
    tm.state_code,
    le_latest.latest_eg as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,
    st.timberland_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_max tm
JOIN latest_eg le_latest ON tm.state_code = le_latest.state_code
JOIN state_totals st ON tm.state_code = st.state_code
JOIN state_names sn ON tm.state_code = sn.state_code

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'forestland' as category,
    fm.state_code,
    le_latest.latest_eg as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,
    st.forestland_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_max fm
JOIN latest_eg le_latest ON fm.state_code = le_latest.state_code
JOIN state_totals st ON fm.state_code = st.state_code
JOIN state_names sn ON fm.state_code = sn.state_code

-- Final query with state_code as string
WITH subplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inventory_year,
    CAST(c.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    AVG(p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) as avg_subplot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
  GROUP BY c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
macroplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inventory_year,
    CAST(c.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    AVG(p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot) as avg_macroplot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'MACR'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
  GROUP BY c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
ranked_sub AS (
  SELECT 
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    'subplot' as plot_type,
    avg_subplot_size as avg_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_subplot_size DESC) as rn
  FROM subplot_sizes
),
ranked_mac AS (
  SELECT 
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    'macroplot' as plot_type,
    avg_macroplot_size as avg_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_macroplot_size DESC) as rn
  FROM macroplot_sizes
)
SELECT inventory_year, state_code, plot_type, avg_size
FROM ranked_sub
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT inventory_year, state_code, plot_type, avg_size
FROM ranked_mac
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY inventory_year, plot_type
SELECT column_name FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS` WHERE table_name = 'v2_1_1_genomes__chr17' ORDER BY ordinal_position

WITH accident_persons AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) AS total_persons,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN p.person_number END) AS severe_injury_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p 
    ON a.state_number = p.state_number 
    AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
  WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number
),
qualifying_accidents AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    total_persons,
    severe_injury_count,
    CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_multiple_severe
  FROM accident_persons
  WHERE total_persons > 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_qualifying_accidents,
  SUM(has_multiple_severe) AS accidents_with_multiple_severe,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(has_multiple_severe) * 100.0, COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_accidents

-- Join person_agg with accident
SELECT 
  pa.consecutive_number,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  a.work_zone,
  pa.num_fatalities
FROM (
  SELECT consecutive_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fatalities
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) > 1
) pa
JOIN (
  SELECT consecutive_number, number_of_drunk_drivers, day_of_week, hour_of_crash, work_zone
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
) a ON pa.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  GeoName,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2017-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2017,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2012,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2017-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS increasing_amount
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips`
WHERE GeoName LIKE '%, MA'
GROUP BY GeoName
ORDER BY increasing_amount ASC

-- Final query using ALL years of EPA data with specified filters
WITH epa_records AS (
    SELECT 
        city_name,
        ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat,
        ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon,
        arithmetic_mean as epa_mean
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.air_quality_annual_summary`
    WHERE parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass'
      AND units_of_measure = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)'
      AND city_name IS NOT NULL
      AND city_name != 'Not in a city'
      AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
),
openaq_records AS (
    SELECT 
        city,
        ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat,
        ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon,
        value as oaq_value
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
    WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020
      AND city IS NOT NULL
      AND value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(e.city_name, o.city) as city,
    ROUND(AVG(e.epa_mean) - AVG(o.oaq_value), 2) as difference
FROM epa_records e
JOIN openaq_records o ON e.lat = o.lat AND e.lon = o.lon
GROUP BY COALESCE(e.city_name, o.city)
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH earliest_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id AS question_id,
    MIN(creation_date) AS earliest_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
question_with_answer AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id AS question_id,
    q.creation_date AS question_date,
    eae.earliest_answer_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM q.creation_date) AS dow_num
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  LEFT JOIN earliest_answers eae ON q.id = eae.question_id
),
daily_pcts AS (
  SELECT 
    dow_num,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN earliest_answer_date IS NOT NULL 
        AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(earliest_answer_date, question_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      COUNT(*)
    ) as pct_answered
  FROM question_with_answer
  GROUP BY dow_num
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dow_num,

high_score_answerers AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a

  WHERE a.score > 5

percentage_answerers AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`

top3_answerers AS (

WITH mapped_proteome AS (

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` m
    ON p.sample_id = m.sample_id
  WHERE m.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
),
rna_expr AS (
  SELECT 
    gene_name,
    sample_barcode,
    sample_type_name,
    fpkm_unstranded,
    LOG(fpkm_unstranded + 1) AS log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current`
  WHERE primary_site = 'Kidney'
    AND sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    mp.gene_symbol,
    mp.sample_type,
    mp.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein,
    re.log_fpkm_plus_1 AS rna
  FROM mapped_proteome mp
  JOIN rna_expr re
    ON mp.sample_submitter_id = re.sample_barcode
    AND mp.gene_symbol = re.gene_name
    AND mp.sample_type = re.sample_type_name
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * rna) - SUM(protein) * SUM(rna),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * protein) - SUM(protein) * SUM(protein)) *
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(rna * rna) - SUM(rna) * SUM(rna))
      )
    ) AS correlation
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
filtered_corr AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM gene_corr
  WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
)
SELECT 
  sample_type,
  AVG(correlation) AS avg_correlation,
  COUNT(*) AS num_genes
FROM filtered_corr
GROUP BY sample_type

WITH cases AS (

events AS (

),
band_events AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.chromosome,
    cb.hg38_start,
    cb.hg38_stop,
    e.CaseNo,
    e.Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
  LEFT JOIN events e 
    ON e.Chr = cb.chromosome
    AND e.Start >= cb.hg38_start AND e.Start < cb.hg38_stop
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    cytoband_name,
    chromosome,
    hg38_start,
    hg38_stop,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Gain' THEN CaseNo END) as amplifications,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Gain' THEN CaseNo END) as gains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Loss' THEN CaseNo END) as losses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Loss' THEN CaseNo END) as homozygous_deletions
  FROM band_events

)

  cytoband_name,

  amplifications,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(amplifications * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as amplifications_freq,
  gains,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(gains * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as gains_freq,
  losses,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(losses * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as losses_freq,
  homozygous_deletions,

FROM agg

-- Final result: top 3 lowest-level pathways with TAS evidence by chi-squared
WITH target_pes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id as pe_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
  )
),
all_tas_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id, pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77`
  WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
lowest_pathways AS (
  SELECT stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77`
  WHERE lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_target_counts AS (
  SELECT ap.pathway_stable_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as targets_in,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.pe_stable_id) as total_in_pathway
  FROM all_tas_pe ap
  LEFT JOIN target_pes tp ON ap.pe_stable_id = tp.pe_stable_id
  WHERE ap.pathway_stable_id IN (SELECT stable_id FROM lowest_pathways)
  GROUP BY ap.pathway_stable_id
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id FROM target_pes)) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id FROM all_tas_pe)) as total_all_pe
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    ptc.pathway_stable_id,
    ptc.targets_in,
    ts.total_targets - ptc.targets_in as targets_out,
    ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in as non_targets_in,
    (ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) - (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in) as non_targets_out,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      ts.total_all_pe * POW(ptc.targets_in * ((ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) - (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in)) - (ts.total_targets - ptc.targets_in) * (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in), 2),
      (ts.total_targets) * (ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) * ptc.total_in_pathway * (ts.total_all_pe - ptc.total_in_pathway)
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_target_counts ptc
  CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  cs.pathway_stable_id,
  p.name as pathway_name,
  cs.chi_squared,
  cs.targets_in as targets_in_pathway,
  cs.targets_out as targets_outside_pathway,
  cs.non_targets_in as non_targets_in_pathway,
  cs.non_targets_out as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM chi_sq cs
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON cs.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
ORDER BY cs.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Step 1: Get channelGrouping + country transaction sums after dedup

WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    channelGrouping,
    geoNetwork_country,
    totals_transactions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits_time) as rn
  FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.rev_transactions`
),
deduped_unique AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, totals_transactions
  FROM deduped
  WHERE rn = 1
),
country_totals AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, SUM(totals_transactions) as total_transactions
  FROM deduped_unique
  GROUP BY channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country
),
multi_country_channels AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping
  FROM country_totals
  GROUP BY channelGrouping
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) > 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.channelGrouping,
    ct.geoNetwork_country,
    ct.total_transactions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.channelGrouping ORDER BY ct.total_transactions DESC) as rn
  FROM country_totals ct
  INNER JOIN multi_country_channels mc ON ct.channelGrouping = mc.channelGrouping
)
SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country as country, total_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY channelGrouping

         MIN(event_date) as install_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
removers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
         MIN(event_timestamp) as remove_ts,
         MIN(event_date) as remove_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_status AS (
  SELECT i.user_pseudo_id,
         i.install_ts,
         i.install_date,
         r.remove_ts,
         r.remove_date,
         CASE 
           WHEN r.remove_ts IS NULL THEN 1
           WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(r.remove_ts), TIMESTAMP_MICROS(i.install_ts), DAY) <= 7 THEN 0
           ELSE 1
         END as qualifies
  FROM installers i
  LEFT JOIN removers r ON i.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(qualifies), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM user_status

-- Final verification: check cohort size and total retained users across all weeks
WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(event_date) BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180708'
),
cohort_first_week AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM cohort_users
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    cu.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_date,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date)) - 2) DAY) as event_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  JOIN cohort_first_week cu ON e.user_pseudo_id = cu.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
),
user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_monday,
    DATE_DIFF(event_monday, cohort_monday, WEEK) as week_offset
  FROM user_events
  JOIN cohort_first_week USING (user_pseudo_id)
),
retention_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    week_offset,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM user_weeks
  WHERE week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 4
  GROUP BY week_offset
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as new_users FROM cohort_users
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Week ', CAST(r.week_offset AS STRING)) as week_identifier,
  c.new_users as total_new_users,
  r.retained_users
FROM retention_counts r
CROSS JOIN cohort_size c
ORDER BY r.week_offset
